plain_text:
AGENDA OF THE TRAFFIC COMMISSION MEETING 
TO BE HELD: THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 19, 2026 AT 10:00 A.M. 
WALTHAM CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER, CITY HALL 
 
The Chair will accept a motion to accept the minutes of the previous meeting(s). 
 
1. PETITIONED ITEMS:  
A. Stow Street Crosswalk Safety (Councillor Katz) 
Councillor Katz is requesting a review of the existing crosswalk on Stow Street, to see if 
visibility can be improved. 
 
   
B. National Grid Gas Main Project, Trapelo Road 
National Grid has submitted a Transportation Management Plan for work along Trapelo Road. 
 
   
C. National Grid Gas Main Project, Newton Street (North of River Street) 
National Grid has submitted a Transportation Management Plan for work along Newton Street 
(north of River Street). 
 
   
D. RiverBeat Festival, Sunday June 20, 2027 
Traffic Commission approval is requested for the RiverBeat Festival scheduled for Sunday June 
20, 2027. 
 
   
E. Steampunk Festival, May 8, 2027 
Traffic Commission approval is requested for the 2027 Steampunk Festival, scheduled for 
Saturday May 8. 
 
   
F. Plympton Street Speed Sign 
A citizen petition has been submitted asking for a radar speed sign along Plympton Street. 
 
   
G. 131 Linden Street, School Bus Yard 
TEPP has submitted a transportation memo for the proposed school bus facility at 131 Linden 
Street. 
 
   
H. Request to Remove Crescent Street Speed Cushions 
A citizen petition has been submitted requesting to permanently remove the speed cushions on 
Crescent Street.
